agency.name: Departamento de Asuntos del Consumidor de Puerto Rico

updateFrequency: unknown; verify against DACO's registered contractors list before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: Puerto Rico DACO registered contractor records exposed by the official registered contractors list
Residential construction, home-repair, roof-treatment, masonry, carpentry, and analogous residential improvement registration records where exposed by DACO
knownExclusions: The DACO page describes residential construction, home repair, alterations, installations, masonry, carpentry, roof treatments, and analogous repair work; commercial contracting and specialist trade scope must be verified against separate official sources.

Professional licenses, Department of State examining-board credentials, DRNA asbestos records, municipal permits, business registrations, complaints, fines, and non-DACO authorizations require separate official sources.
PDF reports or linked exports must not be redistributed unless terms clearly allow it.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Future work should verify whether any linked reports are official, current, stable, and redistribution-safe before local-file support.
publicRecordsNotes: Official DACO contractor-list metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that a registration, license, business authorization, permit, or professional credential does not exist elsewhere.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: DACO may publish contractor-list reports, but no stable bulk format or redistribution permission has been confirmed in this phase.
researchNotes: Registry-only source for Puerto Rico DACO registered contractors. DACO's official page describes a residential construction and home-improvement registration scope; linked reports may include business-type labels such as general construction, solar panels, roof waterproofing, plumbing, and electrical service, but field semantics require adapter research.
maintainerNotes: Preserve Spanish source wording and residential/home-improvement scope in future verification caveats. Do not merge DACO registration with Department of State examining-board credentials.

researchEvidence.note: Official DACO page reviewed; it describes the contractor registry for residential construction, home repairs, alterations, installations, carpentry, masonry, roof treatments, and analogous residential repair work.
Official DACO regulation summary reviewed; it describes the contractor registry as attached to DACO's construction office and focused on residential real-property improvements.

blocker.summary: No stable contractor-specific official file, API, or lookup interface suitable for an adapter was confirmed.
